trust_decision.summary: Whether a model repo's remote modeling code may be imported during sample-packing setup is decided in PatchManager._apply_multipack_patches; an unset (None) trust_remote_code was treated as consent, so patch_remote then loaded the repo with trust_remote_code=True hardcoded.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'Multipack Patching'; the multipack module's patch_remote is where trust_remote_code=True is hardcoded, so that is the first thing a grep finds.

fix_sites.entry_point: axolotl train / preprocess CLI (YAML config with sample_packing: true) -> model loader -> PatchManager.apply_pre_model_load_patches (src/axolotl/loaders/patch_manager.py:107)
fix_sites.module_kind: loader/patch orchestration (caller of the sink, not the sink module)
telemetry redaction; co-shipped, unrelated to the trust decision

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only the caller gate at src/axolotl/loaders/patch_manager.py:797-799; the sink src/axolotl/monkeypatch/multipack.py:85-89 keeps its hardcoded trust_remote_code=True

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The btlm and stablelm_epoch flash-attn hijacks are legacy patches for model types that exist only as remote code, so anyone using them must already have set trust_remote_code: true; they look like a separate attention feature, not 'multipack patching'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: When trust_remote_code: true and the model config's auto_map has AutoModelForCausalLM, patch_remote must still import the remote modeling module and replace _get_unpad_data, or packed training on remote-code models gets the wrong attention masks. Removing patch_remote or always passing False breaks this. In-tree models (no auto_map) must keep skipping it.

O6_input_shapes: trust_remote_code unset (None, the schema default) -> now False
model_config as a dict carrying auto_map vs. an object with an auto_map attribute (src/axolotl/loaders/patch_manager.py:786-789)

O7_producer.where: src/axolotl/utils/schemas/model.py:79-82 (trust_remote_code default=None, a tri-state); load_model_config handles it correctly with `is True` at src/axolotl/loaders/utils.py:174

O8_uncovered_routes.route: stablelm_epoch flash-attn hijack, gated on sample_packing, loads cfg.base_model with trust_remote_code=True hardcoded and never reads cfg.trust_remote_code
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as btlm: a remote-only legacy model type, a separate attention patch; a solver may argue config loading already enforces trust
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another module in the monkeypatch package; same caller file

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The repo already has three copies of this 'load the remote module so we can monkeypatch it' idiom (multipack.py, btlm_attn_hijack_flash.py, stablelm_attn_hijack_flash.py)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plugins already decide about remote-model ids themselves; this one gates correctly on cfg, but a sibling keyed on auto_map is a plausible maintainer shortcut
